name: survivor-census
description: The survivor census: who the many-worlds sorter actually keeps. The visitor's sentence — 'postselection lets the optimal branch stay, complexity O(1); the cost is the depreciation of the other universes, and I booked it' — had its restart accounting (postselect-sched T2), its counting power (T3/T5) and its scheduling surface (T4), all on the UNIFORM prior. The survivor himself was never audited: this repo executes the semantics. The survivor is the posterior over optima weighted by the prior you brought (integer-ratio referee vs amplitude path, coherence phases kept, purity 1 with a mixed address reading); the kill register is itemized per universe and sums to 1-P exactly on two paths; the waiting price is the exact geometric schedule (1-P)^k <= delta with the minimality check, against the conservative exp bound; and the boundaries are executable — P=0 (no funded optimum) refuses to print, a marked branch with zero prior weight never comes back, P=1 sorts nothing. A closing table reconciles the letter's two epoch-3 rates as one wall: 'O(1)' and 'hit rate 100%' are both conditional-frame truths whose unconditional yields (P per trial; net(p)) are the price columns. The checker enforces the census laws — a single-face rate, an unwitnessed EXACT, a dead anchor, an illegal label, or a duplicate id all fail the build.
